claims: The judges for American Idol Season 24 (2026) are Carrie Underwood, Luke Bryan, and Lionel Richie.
Ryan Seacrest is the host for American Idol Season 24 (2026).
American Idol Season 24 (2026) premiered on ABC on January 26, 2026.
American Idol Season 24 (2026) is the second consecutive season for the judge trio of Carrie Underwood, Luke Bryan, and Lionel Richie.
Keke Palmer and Brad Paisley were guest mentors featured during the competition stages of American Idol Season 24 in early 2026.
Hollywood Week in American Idol Season 24 was rebranded as the "Music City Takeover" in Nashville.
The "Music City Takeover" in American Idol Season 24 features a new, high-stakes cut format.
American Idol Season 24 features a "Top 20" competing for spots in the top 14 as of late March 2026.
